entities.name: NORMAL-SERVICE state
entities.description: UE state where normal network services are available and UE can perform various procedures.

entities.name: Mobility registration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE for mobility registration updates according to specified conditions.

entities.name: Periodic registration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE for periodic registration updates, not initiated over non-3GPP access.

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to request services according to specified conditions.

entities.name: Paging response
entities.description: UE action to respond to paging from the network.

entities.name: eCall inactivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by UE configured for eCall only mode at timer expiry.

entities.name: Timer T3444
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers eCall inactivity procedure.

entities.name: Timer T3445
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers eCall inactivity procedure.

entities.name: Timer T3511
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update.

entities.name: eCall only mode configuration
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for eCall only mode as specified in 3GPP TS 31.102.

entities.name: Non-3GPP access
entities.description: Condition indicating access through non-3GPP networks.

relations.description: UE in NORMAL-SERVICE state initiates mobility registration update procedure.
UE in NORMAL-SERVICE state initiates periodic registration update procedure.
UE in NORMAL-SERVICE state initiates service request procedure.
UE in NORMAL-SERVICE state responds to paging.
eCall only mode configuration guards execution of eCall inactivity procedure.
Timer T3444 expiry starts eCall inactivity procedure.
Timer T3445 expiry starts eCall inactivity procedure.
Timer T3511 expiry starts registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update.
Non-3GPP access condition guards against initiating periodic registration update procedure.
